noise.source_description: local dataset/raw/tellonoise noise clips referenced by the w14 run_config

mixing.snr_formula: P_noise_target = P_speech / 10^(SNR_dB/10); scaled_noise = noise * sqrt(P_noise_target / P_noise); mixed = clean + scaled_noise
mixing.noise_match_rule: resample to 16 kHz if needed, then crop or tile to 1.0 s
mixing.clipping_rule: if mixed peak abs > 1.0, divide the whole mixed waveform by that peak

commands.shell_command: MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/matplotlib NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/numba_cache NUMBA_DISABLE_JIT=1 conda run -n drone python scripts/eval_rotor_noise_snr_matrix.py --output-dir weeklyresult/weekly_drone_2026w23/rotor_noise_snr_matrix_20260603
